segments.contextAfter: **`UserModuleMode`**: **Required.** A string you use to determine the degree to which a learner has control over user-editable modules in the book. The module mode must be one of the following types: `"Full"`—User-editable modules that the user can add and remove as needed. `"Limited"`—A nonremovable user module that you supply with your book. `"Disabled"`—No user-editable modules are available. This property is available starting with Swift Playgrounds 3.
